aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden=\"true\">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
